NovaPay SecOps: Hey team — finishing Q3 security review. Customer has a bespoke questionnaire (CAIQ-ish) asking for 90d audit log retention proof and KMS/HSM key custody evidence. We exported logs but the export doesn't include key IDs or HSM attest. Deadline in 3 days, can we get a path to produce acceptable artifacts?
Emma (CS): thanks for flagging. Can you paste the export filename and which deployment (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?
NovaPay SecOps: export name audit-export-2025-06-02.json, this is for their dedicated cluster (dedicated-us-west). When we hit the audit export endpoint it returned a 500 once, then eventually empty key metadata fields.
Raj (Support): @NovaPay SecOps ok — can you share the request-id header from the failing call? also paste the curl you used. quick repro helps.
NovaPay SecOps: here's the curl we ran: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Request-ID: np-req-42" "https://dedicated-us-west.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit/export?from=2025-03-01&to=2025-06-01" -o audit-export-2025-06-02.json``` response body had `{"status":"ok","items":[],"key_metadata":null}` then a 500 on retry with no body.
Tim (Oncall): I looked at the logs for X-Request-ID np-req-42 — we saw a transient upstream timeout to our KMS shim at 2025-06-02T14:12:03Z. That would explain blank key metadata. We were doing a rolling kernel upgrade in that pool.
Leah (Security): For the CAIQ/bespoke evidence, customers usually accept three artifacts: 1) audit log export (JSON) with key_id fields present, 2) KMS key listing export showing key IDs and rotation metadata, 3) HSM attestation statement (signed blob) or our Compliance Pack entry. We can generate (2) and (3) today; need to re-run (1) once the export path is stable.
Emma (CS): Action items: (A) Raj to help repro the export reliably and collect request-ids, (B) Tim to confirm if there are any remaining retries on the KMS shim and if the upgrade window is fully cleared, (C) Leah to prepare KMS key listing + attestation. Kelly will coordinate deadline and communicate to customer.
Raj (Support): repro steps I recommend: 1) Use a server-side token with admin scope, 2) include `X-Request-ID` unique per run, 3) add `?format=full&include_key_metadata=true`. Example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: np-req-43" "https://dedicated-us-west.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit/export?from=2025-03-01&to=2025-06-01&format=full&include_key_metadata=true" -o audit-full.json``` If you still get empty key_metadata, capture response headers and paste here.
NovaPay SecOps: running that now... got 200 and file came back but key_metadata is still `null`. Response headers: `x-rw-request-id: np-req-43`, `x-backend-status: 200`, `x-kms-status: 503`
Tim (Oncall): x-kms-status: 503 means our shim returned 503. I'll check the KMS pool; maybe a retry policy misfired and returned a 503 instead of transparently falling back.
Leah (Security): While Tim investigates, I can export the KMS key list for the customer's tenant: ```/v1/admin/kms/keys?tenant=novapay&format=json``` that will show key_id, created_at, rotation_policy. For HSM attestation we have a signed statement per HSM cluster — I can attach the signed blob and a human-readable summary. That usually satisfies auditors.
Kelly (AM): I'll tell the customer we have a plan: repro + new audit export within 24 hours, KMS key list & HSM attestation ready now, and we'll deliver a short cover note mapping each artifact to their questionnaire sections. FYI they're asking about retention policy length and export verification steps.
Raj (Support): One more note — if the export is heavy it can trigger billing for export-run CPU/GPU time on Dedicated. NovaPay mentioned surprise charges earlier; Kelly can confirm if they had any export-related billing spikes last month.
Kelly (AM): I pulled billing. There was a moderate spike on 2025-05-30 tied to heavy inference jobs, not admin exports. I'll confirm but unlikely the export is the cause. I'll include a billing statement in the packet to avoid confusion.
Tim (Oncall): Update: found a misconfigured healthcheck that marked the KMS shim as unhealthy during the kernel rollout; it returned 503 for ~7m. I've restarted the pool and forced retries — exports now return `x-kms-status: 200`.
NovaPay SecOps: re-run with your suggested curl — now getting key_metadata populated and key_id values present. This should be good for evidence. We'll attach to the questionnaire. Thank you.
Leah (Security): I'll drop the KMS key listing + HSM attestation in a secure S3 link and the compliance cover note. Also note: for long-term audits we recommend enabling continuous audit streaming to the customer's S3 (we can help configure).
IncidentBot: Reminder — ticket #CS-2025-7890 SLA: 72h for bespoke questionnaire delivery. Current status: in-progress.
Emma (CS): Great. Closing loop: Raj will collect final export + response headers, Leah will upload KMS/HSM artifacts, Kelly will send customer-facing packet before deadline. NovaPay SecOps, please confirm when you have the final files and I'll mark the thread resolved. :thumbsup:
